title: Linear recurrence sequences and palindromic concatenations of two repdigits in base $β$
summary: Let $β$ be a non-unit real algebraic integer greater than one and $\{a_{n}\}_{n \geq 0}$ be a sequence satisfying a linear recurrence relation $a_{n+3}=aa_{n+2}+ba_{n+1}+ca_{n}$. Under certain conditions, we prove that the number of $a_{n}$ which are palindromic concatenations of two repdigits in base $β$ is finite.
